During the 2000-01 season [[AS Roma]] competed in [[Serie A]], [[Coppa Italia]] and [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]].

==Summary==
In 2001, '''[[AS Roma|Associazione Sportiva Roma]]''' took its third league title (after 1942 and 1983), winning [[Serie A]] only a year after local rivals [[SS Lazio|Lazio]]. Important signings for the season were [[Argentina|Argentines]] [[Walter Samuel]], a [[Defender (association football)|defender]], and [[Gabriel Batistuta]], a top [[Forward (association football)|striker]]. Manager [[Fabio Capello]]'s line-up also included [[Cafu]], [[Vincent Candela]], [[Emerson (footballer, born 1976)|Emerson]], [[Vincenzo Montella]] and captain [[Francesco Totti]].

Capello won [[Serie A]] once again when on the last matchday Roma defeated [[Parma AC|Parma]] 3–1 at home with Totti, Montella and Batistuta scoring.
